introduction_markdown: General Certificate of Education (GCE) Board, Ordinary Level, June 2024. Additional Mathematics 2 (code 0575), Paper 2. Duration: two and a half hours. Answer ALL questions in SECTION A and ANY TWO questions from EITHER SECTION B or SECTION C. In Sections B and C, all questions carry equal marks. Candidates are expected to answer a combination of Section A and Section B OR Section A and Section C, but NOT a combination of all three. Section A: Pure Mathematics (compulsory, answer all questions, questions 1 to 8). Section B: Mechanics (answer any two questions, questions 9 to 11; if this section is chosen, Section C may not be chosen). Section C: Statistics and Probability (answer any two questions, questions 12 to 14; if this section is chosen, Section B may not be chosen). All necessary working must be shown. No marks will be awarded for answers without brief statements showing how the answers have been obtained. Electronic calculators and Formulae Booklets are allowed. Where necessary take g as 10 m s^-2.

figures.legende: Smooth plane inclined at 30 degrees to the horizontal; a 3 kg block on the plane is joined by a string over a pulley at the top of the plane to a 6 kg block hanging vertically.

incertitudes: Q9(i) : l'unite de x est le centimetre (x cm) ; v est donc en cm/s et a en cm/s^2, comme dans le sujet.
Q9(ii) : P (6 kg) est la particule suspendue et Q (3 kg) celle posee sur le plan, comme sur la figure ; plan et poulie lisses, g = 10 m/s^2.
Q9(iii) : le sujet donne « moving with speed 3 ms-1 » et « collides directly with a stationary particle B » : lecture standard (conservation de la quantite de mouvement, coalescence).

Regles de choix : la consigne imprimee est « Section A obligatoire, puis DEUX questions de la Section B OU DEUX de la Section C, jamais un melange des trois ». Le systeme ne sait exprimer que « 2 parmi 3 » par section ; l'exclusivite B ou C est recopiee dans introduction_markdown mais n'est pas appliquee par les regles_choix.

Points : le sujet imprime des points par sous-question, pas de total par question. Le champ points de chaque exercice est la somme des points imprimes des sous-questions (Section A : 8 ou 9 ; Sections B et C : 17, ce qui est coherent avec « all questions carry equal marks » ; total 66 + 17 + 17 = 100).
Le sujet est une photo numerisee (CamScanner) : texte lu en image page par page ; les filigranes (gcerevision.com, Kawlo) ont ete ignores.

questions.enonce_markdown:
9. (i) The particle moves from the origin $O$ along the $x$-axis, $OX$, so that its distance $x$ cm from $O$ at time $t$ seconds is given by $x=2t^3-6t^2+t$.

Find

a) the velocity of the particle after $t=3$ seconds. *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Velocity is the derivative of displacement with respect to time:

$$v=\frac{dx}{dt}=6t^2-12t+1.$$

At $t=3$: $v=6(9)-12(3)+1=54-36+1=19$.

**Answer: $v=19$ cm s$^{-1}$.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (i)(b) The acceleration of the particle after $t=3$ seconds. *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Acceleration is the derivative of velocity:

$$a=\frac{dv}{dt}=12t-12.$$

At $t=3$: $a=12(3)-12=24$.

**Answer: $a=24$ cm s$^{-2}$.**

questions.enonce_markdown:
(ii)

![fig-1](gce-ol-additional-maths-2024-p2-officiel-cameroun_exercice_9_fig_1.png)

Two particles $P$ and $Q$ of mass $6\,\text{kg}$ and $3\,\text{kg}$ respectively are connected by a light inextensible string which passes over a smooth fixed pulley at the top of a smooth plane inclined at $30^\circ$ to the horizontal. Given that the string is taut and the system is released from rest with particle $6\,\text{kg}$ hanging vertically, find

a) their common acceleration. *[4 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Take $g=10\ \text{m s}^{-2}$. Let $T$ be the tension and $a$ the common acceleration (the $6$ kg particle moves down, the $3$ kg particle moves up the plane).

**$6$ kg particle** (down is positive): $6g-T=6a$, that is

$$60-T=6a.\qquad(1)$$

**$3$ kg particle** (up the plane is positive; the plane is smooth, so there is no friction). The weight component along the plane is $3g\sin30^\circ=3(10)(0.5)=15$ N:

$$T-15=3a.\qquad(2)$$

Add (1) and (2): $45=9a$, so $a=5$.

Check by the system method: driving force $60-15=45$ N for a total mass of $9$ kg gives $a=45/9=5$.

**Answer: $a=5\ \text{m s}^{-2}$.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (ii)(b) the tension in the string. *[2 marks]*

(iii) A particle $A$, of mass $2\,\text{kg}$, moving with speed $3\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ collides directly with a stationary particle $B$ of mass $4\,\text{kg}$. Given that after the collision $A$ and $B$ coalesce and move with a common speed $v$.

Find:

a) the value of $v$. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Conservation of momentum (the particles join together after the collision):

$$m_Au_A+m_Bu_B=(m_A+m_B)v\;\Rightarrow\;2(3)+4(0)=(2+4)v.$$

So $6=6v$ and $v=1$.

**Answer: $v=1\ \text{m s}^{-1}$.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (iii)(b) the loss in kinetic energy due to the collision. *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Kinetic energy before: $\tfrac12(2)(3)^2+\tfrac12(4)(0)^2=9$ J.

Kinetic energy after: $\tfrac12(2+4)(1)^2=3$ J.

Loss $=9-3=6$ J.

**Answer: the loss in kinetic energy is $6$ J.**
